source.row_text: a grant for reviewer B cannot be consumed with round_open.tester_job_id=null or reviewer C; both return grant_invalid. A valid exact-B open followed by verdict.tester_job_id=null/C fails the assignment check. A reviewer claim ended/reaped before new verdict append gives round_not_open for that assignment; exact successful replay remains available. A reviewer ending after accepted PASS has no effect on later joined acceptance. Aborted live verdict-free open -> valid void -> new same-head open is allowed without head_repeat if no other live open or actual verdict reserves the head. The void does not allow copying a prior verdict path/bytes.
